{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Correct the data: only consider completed orders for conversion
# Because 'converted' is unreliable when status is not 'completed'
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now filter for new customers reached by paid search, among completed orders
new_paid_search_completed = completed_only[(completed_only['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (completed_only['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of these who converted (i.e., converted == 1)
converted_count = new_paid_search_completed['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(new_paid_search_completed)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0

# Print results
print(f'Number of new paid_search customers with completed status: {total_count}')
print(f'Number of converted among them: {converted_count}')
print(f'Conversion rate (fraction): {conversion_rate}')

# Store for submission
findings = {
    'total_new_paid_search_completed': total_count,
    'converted_count': converted_count,
    'conversion_rate': conversion_rate
}

findings"}
